description: MetaRalph Phases 2-8 Consolidated: Complete core functionality including work queue, worker orchestration, CLI dashboard, onboarding, collaboration, learning, and self-improvement.

userStories.title: Create task model with priority scoring
userStories.description: As a developer, I need task management with quick-wins-first priority scoring.
acceptanceCriteria: src/queue/task.ts exports Task interface with: id, projectId, type, title, source, priorityScore, estimatedEffort, requiresApproval, approvalStatus, status, prdJson
src/queue/prioritizer.ts exports calculatePriorityScore() using: typeScore * effortMultiplier * confidence
Type scores: bug_fix=100, test=90, docs=85, refactor=70, feature=50
Effort multipliers: quick_win=2.0, small=1.5, medium=1.0, large=0.5
TaskRepository with create(), findById(), findPending(), getNextTasks()
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement approval queue with auto-approve logic
userStories.description: As a user, I want bug fixes/docs/tests to auto-execute while features need approval.
acceptanceCriteria: src/queue/approval.ts exports categorizeTask() returning 'auto' or 'needs_approval'
Auto-approve: type in ['bug_fix', 'docs', 'test'] AND effort in ['quick_win', 'small']
ApprovalQueue class with: submit(), approve(), reject(), getPending()
CLI commands: 'metaralph queue', 'metaralph approve <id>', 'metaralph reject <id>'
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement execution tracking and Ralph spawner
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to spawn Ralph instances and track their execution.
acceptanceCriteria: src/workers/execution.ts exports Execution interface with: id, taskId, pid, status, iterationsUsed, ralphOutput
src/workers/ralph-spawner.ts exports RalphSpawner.spawn(task, project) that creates prd.json and runs ralph.sh
Captures stdout/stderr, detects '<promise>COMPLETE</promise>' for success
ExecutionRepository with create(), update(), findRunning()
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement worker orchestrator with concurrency control
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an orchestrator to manage concurrent Ralph workers.
acceptanceCriteria: src/workers/index.ts exports WorkerOrchestrator class
Enforces maxConcurrentWorkers from config and one worker per project
scheduleTask(task) spawns worker if capacity available
Monitors workers for completion, updates task/execution status
src/workers/failure-handler.ts handles retries (up to 2) with exponential backoff
CLI: 'metaralph workers' shows active workers
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement queue manager scheduling loop
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the daemon to continuously process the work queue.
acceptanceCriteria: src/queue/index.ts exports QueueManager class
start() begins scheduling loop (runs every 5 seconds)
Loop: check capacity -> get next tasks -> schedule via WorkerOrchestrator
Integrates with daemon lifecycle (starts on daemon start, stops on stop)
Emits events: 'task:scheduled', 'task:completed', 'task:failed'
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Set up Ink dashboard framework with tab navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I need a terminal UI to monitor and control MetaRalph.
acceptanceCriteria: src/cli/dashboard.tsx exports Dashboard component using Ink
'metaralph' or 'metaralph dashboard' launches the TUI
Tab navigation: [1]Queue [2]Approvals [3]Projects [4]Workers
Header shows version and daemon status, footer shows keyboard shortcuts
q quits, 1-4 switches tabs
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement Queue and Approvals dashboard views
userStories.description: As a user, I need to see and manage tasks from the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: src/cli/components/QueueView.tsx shows tasks table with: Priority, ID, Project, Type, Status
src/cli/components/ApprovalView.tsx shows pending tasks with full details
Arrow keys navigate, 'a' approves, 'r' rejects in ApprovalView
Views refresh automatically when data changes
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement Projects and Workers dashboard views
userStories.description: As a user, I need to manage projects and monitor workers from the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: src/cli/components/ProjectsView.tsx shows projects grouped by group with health scores
src/cli/components/WorkersView.tsx shows running workers with progress
'a' in ProjectsView prompts to add project, 'd' removes with confirmation
WorkersView shows iteration progress and last output lines
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement codebase analyzer and TODO extractor
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to analyze projects when they're added.
acceptanceCriteria: src/onboarding/analyzer.ts exports CodebaseAnalyzer.analyze(path) returning ImprovementOpportunity[]
Detects: outdated deps (npm outdated), type errors, lint issues if available
src/onboarding/todo-extractor.ts extracts TODO/FIXME/XXX/HACK with file:line
Categorizes findings by type and estimates effort

userStories.title: Implement onboarding engine with proposal generation
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to generate improvement proposals when projects are onboarded.

Pipeline: validate git -> analyze -> extract TODOs -> generate proposals
src/onboarding/proposal-generator.ts creates Task objects from findings
Updates project.lastAnalyzed, creates initial conversation with summary
'metaralph projects analyze <id>' triggers re-analysis

userStories.title: Implement conversation model and discussion engine
userStories.description: As a user, I need to have conversations with MetaRalph about projects.

userStories.title: Implement learning application to new tasks

userStories.title: Register Ralph and MetaRalph as self-managed projects
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to treat my own codebases as self-improvement targets.

userStories.title: Implement sandboxed self-execution with rollback

userStories.title: Implement self-improvement coordinator with safety guardrails
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to orchestrate the self-improvement loop safely.
